tool_args.rationale: The short-H pilot is compatible with short-window positive gain but leaves the four-parameter dual-horizon reversal underidentified for the H=20 target. Acquire the recommended slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: author dual-exponential reversal model from initial five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations have H≤0.48, so they do not identify the slow-timescale behavior needed for the H=20 forecast.
The supplied evidence and probe guidance favor distinguishing the long-horizon reversal directly; this lower-cost probe would not calibrate that horizon.
Fine short-range trajectory data would not resolve the slow-horizon ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to the stated competing mechanisms and should not be purchased.
